summary: OFAC announced 'Operation Economic Outcast', adding two Iranian individuals and roughly 30 entities to the SDN List for sanctions evasion tied to Iran's automotive and rail sectors (EO 13871/EO 13902), alongside a separate Transnational Criminal Organization designation (A7 Network) and two name/property amendments. The core network comprises newly incorporated trading companies in Hong Kong, China, the UAE, Turkey, Indonesia and Germany, several explicitly tagged 'Linked To' designated Iranian individuals (Ramin Keshvardoust, Mehnoosh Poursaraf Hamedani) or to major Iranian automotive and rail manufacturers (HEPCO, Iran Khodro, Saipa, Zamyad, the Islamic Republic of Iran Railway Company, Raja Passenger Trains). OFAC also published an EO 13902 sectoral determination covering Iran's automotive and rail sectors and an amended Iran-related FAQ (831).

extraction_notes: Actor resolution: all 18 named actors returned 'Unresolved' from knowledge_centre_resolve_actor (none are existing identities in the register). For A7 NETWORK, the tool additionally returned similar-name suggestions (ACT-cd34bc99b1 Avalanche network; ACT-7aec1dbb9f QQAAZZ; ACT-92fd666c89 Zarringhalam shadow banking network, all score 1.00) -- these are suggestions only, not an identity, and none is clearly the correct match given A7 Network's stated Russia/Kyrgyzstan/Nigeria/Zimbabwe footprint. For ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN RAILWAY COMPANY, the tool suggested ACT-c112e4cc46 'Islamic Republic of Iran Shipping Lines' (score 0.60) -- a different entity, not treated as an identity. This record extracts a representative subset of the roughly 30 entities added to the SDN List in the source document (the two individuals, the TCO network, the five Hong Kong/China front companies explicitly tied by 'Linked To' tags to the two individuals or to HEPCO, the six core Iranian automotive/rail manufacturers, and the Germany-based entity linked to Esfahan's Mobarakeh Steel Company); the remaining ~15 SDN additions (e.g. Hessenberg/Jedburgh, Integrated Auto Parts LLC, Iran Khodro Diesel, KGT Trading, Meizi, Niroo Motor Damavand, Niroo Motor Shiraz, Pars Khodro, PT Golden Motorcycle International, Sherkat-e Rah Ahan-e Khamle-o-Naghle, Silver Line Metal Trading, Tanex Global Trading, Traco International FZE, Troy Trading, and the Ever Shining/Fluxus Marine list-maintenance amendments) follow the same front-company pattern but were not individually transcribed given volume. No typology was recorded for the A7 Network TCO designation itself: the document gives only the bare designation (jurisdictions, establishment date, TCO tag) with no described modus operandi, so there is no technique to pin to a typology. Jurisdiction codes for Hong Kong (HK) and Dominica (DM) are listed separately from China (CN) and Iran (IR) per ISO 3166-1.
